Description

Charnwood Golf and Leisure Complex near Loughborough have a number of fantastic facilities available to hire on both an ad hoc and block booking basis.

The venue houses two excellently maintained 3G Astroturf football pitches which are perfect for those looking to play 5 a side football. Bookings for the pitches can be made via the online calendar above, while block booking enquiries can be sent via the enquiry form on this page.

The venue also offers a range of top quality golfing facilities which include mini golf and a golf range for which those interested can enquire with the form on this page.

For any sportspeople looking to for refreshments after their game, or bring an additional social element to their game can make use of the on site sports bar. Whether your looking to run an event, play football, or brush up on your golf swing Charnwood Golf and Leisure Centre has what you need.

The venue is fully floodlit and has on site changing facilities and free parking for its customers.
